step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Nodes: Visual analysis reveals Amazon S3 (labeled DATALAKE), AWS Batch (labeled BATCH), Amazon EC2 (labeled EC2), Amazon FSx (labeled FSX), Amazon EventBridge (labeled EVENTBRIDGE), AWS Lambda (labeled LAMBDA), and Amazon OpenSearch/Elasticsearch (labeled ELASTICSEARCH).
2. Identify Edges based on physical arrows on the board:
   - S3 and FSX are connected bidirectionally via Data Repository Task (DRT).
   - BATCH points to FSX (orchestration/mounting).
   - BATCH points to EVENTBRIDGE (Events).
   - EVENTBRIDGE points to LAMBDA.
   - LAMBDA connects bidirectionally to OpenSearch (indexing and querying status/logs).
3. Match canonical services: S3, Batch, EC2, FSX, EventBridge, Lambda, OpenSearch.
